{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace BridgeContract

inductive Edge where
  | mk (u v : Nat)

inductive Graph where
  | mk (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge)

def edgeU (e : Edge) : Nat :=
  match e with | Edge.mk u v => u

def edgeV (e : Edge) : Nat :=
  match e with | Edge.mk u v => v

def graphN (g : Graph) : Nat :=
  match g with | Graph.mk n _ => n

def graphEdges (g : Graph) : List Edge :=
  match g with | Graph.mk _ es => es

def edgeId (g : Graph) (e : Edge) : Nat :=
  (graphEdges g).indexOf e

def removeEdge (g : Graph) (e : Edge) : Graph :=
  Graph.mk (graphN g) ((graphEdges g).filter (fun x => x != e))

def connected (g : Graph) (a b : Nat) : Bool :=
  let n := graphN g
  if a = b then true
  else
    let rec dfs (cur : Nat) (visited : List Nat) : Bool :=
      if visited.contains cur then false
      else
        let neighbors := (graphEdges g).filter (fun e =>
          (edgeU e = cur && edgeV e < n) || (edgeV e = cur && edgeU e < n)
        ).map (fun e => if edgeU e = cur then edgeV e else edgeU e)
        if neighbors.contains b then true
        else
          let newVisited := visited ++ [cur]
          let rec checkAll (lst : List Nat) : Bool :=
            match lst with
            | [] => false
            | x :: xs => if dfs x newVisited then true else checkAll xs
          checkAll neighbors
    dfs a []

def connectedComponents (g : Graph) : Nat :=
  let n := graphN g
  let rec count (i : Nat) (visited : List Nat) : Nat :=
    if i >= n then 0
    else if visited.contains i then count (i + 1) visited
    else
      let rec mark (cur : Nat) (acc : List Nat) : List Nat :=
        if acc.contains cur then acc
        else
          let neighbors := (graphEdges g).filter (fun e =>
            (edgeU e = cur && edgeV e < n) || (edgeV e = cur && edgeU e < n)
          ).map (fun e => if edgeU e = cur then edgeV e else edgeU e)
          let rec markAll (lst : List Nat) (acc2 : List Nat) : List Nat :=
            match lst with
            | [] => acc2
            | x :: xs => markAll xs (mark x acc2)
          let newVisited := markAll neighbors (acc ++ [cur])
          count (i + 1) newVisited
  count 0 []

def isBridge (g : Graph) (e : Edge) : Bool :=
  let u := edgeU e
  let v := edgeV e
  if u = v then false
  else if connected g u v then false
  else true

def solve (g : Graph) : List Nat :=
  (graphEdges g).map (fun e => edgeId g e)
    .filter (fun i => isBridge g (graphEdges g).get! i))
    .sort

def validN (n : Nat) : Prop := n ≤ 10

def validEdges (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  let n := graphN g
  (graphEdges g).all (fun e => edgeU e < n ∧ edgeV e < n)

def valid (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  validN (graphN g) ∧ validEdges g

def sortedList (l : List Nat) : Prop :=
  l.all (fun x => l.all (fun y => x ≤ y))

def isSorted (l : List Nat) : Prop :=
  l.all (fun x => l.all (fun y => x ≤ y))

def inRange (l : List Nat) (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  l.all (fun i => i < (graphEdges g).length)

def distinct (l : List Nat) : Prop :=
  l.all (fun x => l.all (fun y => x = y → x = y))

def noSelfLoops (l : List Nat) (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  l.all (fun i => ¬ (edgeU (graphEdges g).get! i) = (edgeV (graphEdges g).get! i))

def bridgeProperty (l : List Nat) (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  l.all (fun i => isBridge g (graphEdges g).get! i)) ∧
  ((graphEdges g).map (fun e => edgeId g e)).all (fun i =>
    if l.contains i then isBridge g (graphEdges g).get! i
    else ¬ isBridge g (graphEdges g).get! i))

def deterministic (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  solve g = solve g

def pure (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  solve g = solve g

def jsonCompatible (l : List Nat) : Prop :=
  l.all (fun x => x = x)

def noSideEffects (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  True

def stdLibOnly : Prop :=
  True

theorem thm_O1 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) : 
  isSorted (solve g) ∧ inRange (solve g) g ∧ bridgeProperty (solve g) g := by sorry

theorem thm_O2 (g : Graph) : deterministic g ∧ pure g := by sorry

theorem thm_O3 : stdLibOnly := by sorry

theorem thm_O4 (g : Graph) : noSideEffects g := by sorry

theorem thm_O5 (g : Graph) : jsonCompatible (solve g) := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity : 
  ∃ (g : Graph), valid g ∧ solve g = [] ∧ 
  ∃ (g2 : Graph), valid g2 ∧ solve g2 ≠ [] := by sorry

end BridgeContract",
